title: Touchard's identity and a detailed determination of the radius of convergence of the Catalan series
summary: While the value of the radius of convergence of the generating series of the Catalan numbers is well-known, obtaining it solely from recurrence relations is less immediate. It is sometimes considered that no known proof establishes that the radius $R$ equals 1/4 without relying on the explicit closed formula for the Catalan numbers. In particular, it has been shown that one can obtain, at the cost of substantial technical effort and without resorting to the main Segner recursion relation or to the explicit formula for the Catalan number, the lower bound $R\geq 1/6$.
